lineage: render check R1, 2026-09-29 (docs/engine/rendercheck/00-PLAN.md defects 1 and 2: the render check's decks, d3_s13 and d1_s07)
notes: Boxes with no text of their own inside an inline run. Before R1 each case here but G exported nothing and said nothing:
inlineSegments made tokens from text nodes only, so an in an inline was never detached or walked
(defect 1), and a paragraph with no measured text never reached flushText, the only painter of its inline boxes (defect 2).
A the chevrons of d3_s13: a circled number (.num, inline-block, text '1') and an icon span (.cico, inline-block,
24 x 24, margin-left 14 px, no text) holding a currentColor <svg>, one filled and one stroked. The icon span is the
special's owner (the outermost atomic inline box around the <svg> with no text of the paragraph) and always detaches;
the number shares its paragraph with that box and has geometry of its own (20 px wide, its text 6), so it detaches too
(package B's R3): '1' and '2' are elements of their own over their circles. The icons are white: svg.js resolves
currentColor through getComputedStyle (.cico's color).
B an <svg> alone in an inline <span> (the owner is the <svg> itself), and one in a text-less inline-block ring span with
a fill (the owner is the ring: walked as an element, its roundRect under the tick).
C inline-flex icon + label, bare and as a filled pill. The pill has text, so it stays in its paragraph (alone, it is
glued to nothing) and only the <svg> leaves it: the pill's fill paints first (walkDetached paints a detached box's
inline ancestors before it), then the dot, then 'On track', which starts where the browser put it, after the gap.
D a span-wrapped <svg> mid-sentence: 'Revenue grew' and 'twelve per cent on the year' are hugged segments each side
of the triangle (2 text elements), no double space where the icon was. E the same with an in a .
F rows of empty inline-block dots (d1_s07): filled with no whitespace between them, border-only with whitespace, and
a centred mixed row above a 'Low' label. None has a character to measure; addParagraph's fallback (paintInline)
paints each row's inline boxes at once, or after the pending text. G a dots-only row in a table cell: the table
walk already drew these (emitCellChip); the case keeps it so.
Counts: text 18 = the seven case labels + A 4 ('1', 'Governance', '2', 'Reach') + C 2 + D 2 + E 2 + F 1 ('Low').
shape 35 = A 13 (2 chevron fills, 2 number rings, 6 + 3 icon shapes: a polygon and five rects, a circle and two
